The terms available are bad. They are better than March 1918's, and they cost the alliance permanently. The territory conceded is territory. The alternative on the present trajectory is the same territory conceded later by people with nothing to offer.The front · 28 January 1917Expand the mapBaranovichiLvovGorliceMogilevBerdichevPskovPetrograd-10MANPOWER ▾-9MUNITIONS ▾0HOME STABILITY ▾Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Separate-peace soundings existed and none came to anything. The obstacle was never arithmetic. It was that the dynasty could not sign such a thing and remain the dynasty. What actually happened: Russia did not leave the war on its own initiative in 1917. It was taken out of it by revolution, first in March, when the Provisional Government that replaced the monarchy pledged to continue the war with the Allies, and again in November, when the government that replaced that one did not. The Emperor, who in this ending makes a separate peace, did not do so, and the Allies' loans went on until the revolution.
